name: Spark Hire
summary: Spark Hire sells applicant tracking and video interviewing. Its pricing page lists Recruit Pro from $335 a month and the Video Interviews plan from $249 a month, both billed annually. The pages cover one-way and live video interviews, self-service scheduling and scorecards.

facts.text: The pricing page lists one-way video interviews on Recruit Pro, Growth and Enterprise, and unlimited live and one-way video interviews on the Video Interviews plan.
The pricing page lists self-service interview scheduling on Recruit Pro, Growth and Enterprise. Automated panel scheduling is listed for Growth and Enterprise only.
The pricing page lists configurable interview scorecards for evaluation on the Video Interviews plan, and customizable scorecards on Growth and Enterprise.
The pricing page says prices exclude applicable sales tax and vary by company size.
